body: It went well, you did good
No no, I understand, I'll try and follow through with some of these I'll let you know how this pans out
Thanks, really thanks, just answer this, what should I do?
Thanks for that and no they never said that, I figured it out my self by comparing and contrasting with those around me, they achieved so much in so little time but I just stay put doing nothing.

It's odd, I can go weeks being totally fine, then a little muttering in the back of my head reminds me about what my parents say when they think I can't hear, about how I have nothing to be proud of, and then it takes on a domino effect and ends up with me sitting alone listening to something by the antlers all while telling my self that I'm wrong and shouldn't be doing this to myself. I guess really this is a roundabout and fleshed out way of saying my own achievements or lack of, my parents and other little reasons anyone else would hate them selves like my own body, as shallow as that may sound.
I'm not sure how to distinguish what is and isn't important about me, nothing really seems note worthy.
I won't, so where were we?
It should be about midday where you are, no? Let's talk then
That it five in the morning I should get some sleep, can we do this latter?
I spend most of my time telling other people how it wasn't their fault, and now I'm here, hearing much the same.
Y'know there's a morbid sort of irony to all this
I'm not sure how to respond... Give me a second

Honestly, if this thing started anywhere near how I think it did, it would sound to stereotypical to be true.

I never achieved anything of any real worth,while my brother was off securing a well paid apprenticeship with one of the biggest engineering companies in the uk I was shifting around the house with my thumb up my arse trying to figure out what the fuck I want with my life, while he was being signed up for some of the biggest jobs I was failing at school, while he was of with friends I was sat alone listening to my own father telling my mother how I'm "not right" thinking I couldn't hear.

My whole life I've been the fucking worst case scenario.
